items.geometry: Cylindrical, vertical reactor (pilot-scale photo and description)
items.localisation_of_the_catalyst: Whole cell biocatalyst (HheG from Ilumatobacter coccineus) suspended in aqueous phase; also tested as cell lysate (soluble enzyme)
items.material: Not explicitly stated for reactor; pilot-scale reactor brand: Dongsen EXDS/JGRL; 10 mL glass vials for small scale (material: glass)
items.reactor_type: Tubular flow/continuous reactor not explicitly stated; pilot-scale described as a stirred tank reactor (batch mode); small scale: glass vials (batch mode)
items.special_treatment: Temperature controlled (pilot-scale: exothermic, maintained at 25°C); two-phase system with ethyl acetate as co-solvent for substrate solubility and self-pH control; cell lysate prepared by lysozyme pre-treatment for some experiments; post-processing includes centrifugation, phase separation, concentration, and crystallization with heptane.
